task_contract.system_prompt: Return raw claims and exact locators from one selected table only. Copy the supplied shard_id exactly and return examined_table_ids equal to every supplied shard table_id in original order. If the role is present, return shard_disposition CANDIDATE_PRESENT and use the existing exact candidate, same-target-table locator, scope, unit, and competing-candidate contract.
